notes.title: Mystic
notes.content:
[h1]Mystic is live on the Playtest![/h1]

Have a gander at an early access scene with the Games Club, and the reclusive Liz Seiler.

This brief look at the Games Club should leave you wanting more, I hope. Other than that, I'm just happy to be getting [i]something[/i] live.

notes.title: Blue Hour
notes.content:
[h1]Blue Hour is live on the Playtest![/h1]

Get your first taste of an early access scene with the Photography Club's Queen, Kelly Brooks.

This short sequence takes place a little after you've started your membership at the college's most prestigious club and it'll give you precious insight into Kelly.
